customer_name: IBM Office of Privacy and Responsible Technology
business_problem: IBM’s Office of Privacy and Responsible Technology needed to connect data, privacy, and AI governance mechanisms that were operating separately so the company could scale AI innovation without weakening regulatory compliance, provenance controls, or trust.
solution_summary: IBM’s Office of Privacy and Responsible Technology built the Integrated Governance Program as a unified control plane for responsible AI and data usage. The program extends the earlier Privacy and AI Management System by connecting intake, procurement, research, development, and re-use processes into one governance workflow. To do that, OPRT integrates IBM watsonx.governance, IBM Cloud Pak for Data, IBM Knowledge Catalog, and IBM OpenPages so data sources, models, privacy reviews, and risk decisions can be tracked end to end instead of through separate processes. The resulting system gives business-unit AI leads a holistic view of what data and models exist, what standards apply, and what approvals or provenance checks are required, which helps IBM enforce uniform internal standards without slowing development. It also directly supports IBM’s own AI products, including Granite models, by giving teams faster access to approved, high-quality inputs and a clear governance path for new technologies such as agentic AI.

solution_components.name: Privacy and AI Management System
solution_components.role: Provides the initial management framework for ML reliability, privacy compliance, and transparency that IGP extends.

solution_components.name: Integrated Governance Program
solution_components.role: Unifies data, privacy, and AI governance workflows across sourcing, development, and re-use.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.governance
solution_components.role: Supplies AI governance controls used inside the integrated workflow.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Supports the governed data-management environment underlying the integrated workflow.

solution_components.name: IBM Knowledge Catalog
solution_components.role: Improves visibility and cataloging of governed datasets and models.

solution_components.name: IBM OpenPages
solution_components.role: Supports the risk and compliance management aspects of the integrated governance workflow.

data_flow: Data and model requests move through intake and provenance checks in IGP, governed assets are cataloged and reviewed with Cloud Pak for Data, Knowledge Catalog, OpenPages, and watsonx.governance, and the resulting approvals and standards feed back into AI development, re-use, and compliance workflows.
business_outcome: IBM reduced clearance-processing times, approved large numbers of datasets and models for reuse, and created a reusable governance pattern that supports trusted AI development internally and for partner ecosystems.
metrics: 58% reduction in data clearance request processing time for third-party data
62% reduction in data clearance request processing time for IBM-proprietary data
>2000 data sets and models approved for potential re-use
architecture_clues: IGP provides a holistic end-to-end view of data and models built and used by IBM.
The program was layered on top of PIMS rather than replacing privacy controls entirely.
The design is intended to support emerging technologies such as agentic AI in addition to current model workflows.
